findings: learner.overview.text: Replace “it may directly represent four” with a clear distinction between early numeral forms written 亖, which are described as directly representing four and as coexisting with forms written 四, and the separate interpretation of some 四 forms as counting rods. Then distinguish both from the competing borrowing proposals: one treats 四 as a breath-related graph associated with 呬, later borrowed for “four,” without establishing the referent’s ancient name; the other proposes 四 was the original graph for 泗 (“nasal discharge”), later borrowed for “four,” and is explicitly said to lack textual attestation. Keep the 囗 enclosure and inner 儿-form strokes explicitly as the present visible structure, not an account of ancient roles.
